dedupe_keys.name: uso de estaciones de carga publica de epm para vehiculos electricos 2019 2025

description: Uso de estaciones de carga pública de EPM para vehículos eléctricos (2019-2025) is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by E.S.P. Empresas Públicas de Medellín - EPM, Antioquia. Este conjunto de datos muestra la cantidad de recargas realizadas a vehículos eléctricos en las estaciones de carga pública de EPM, entre enero de 2019 y junio de 2025. La información está organizada por quincenas y presenta un total mensual para facilitar el seguimiento del uso de este servicio. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher E.S.P. Empresas Públicas de Medellín - EPM, Antioquia. Its tags are vehiculos, consumos, recarga, estaciones, movilidad. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
